exceptions.rationale: Torch 2.11.0 requires setuptools<82. The advisory affects Unicode-normalization handling while building source distributions on macOS; Facetorch's official platform and release builders are Linux.
mitigations: Facetorch source distributions use an isolated setuptools>=83 build backend.
Release jobs reject non-Linux production targets.
The runtime environment does not invoke setuptools to build source distributions.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when a validated Torch 2.11 patch no longer requires vulnerable setuptools, or drop the cohort.
